svg.title: Front face ghosts at stage 1
svg.desc: Surface (upper lines) and crust base (lower lines) on the front face for the three boundaries at stage 1; thin grey line is the shared start. The range rises and its root deepens where the rift sinks and its crust thins; the transform matches the start.
svg.text: Front face ghosts, stage 1: surface (top) and crust base (bottom)
Each boundary already viewed is drawn as a labelled profile at the same stage. Heights ×4; crust base ×0.75.
